# Revise photography section of the repo (2025-11-15 03:07Z)

_**User (2025-11-15 03:06Z)**_

We want to revise our Photography portion of our repo and have it match the setup we have been doing with the Documents, Side Projects (Projects), Portfolios and related.



We will create the links on the backend admin sidebar in place of what is there now that says “Coming Soon”.  We can create a sub directory called `photography/` where the templates, database and related will stay.  the root file `photography.html` will be replaced or modified to pull the data from the SQLite database but keep the same structure, design, layout and related.



The backend admin pages we will have the following pages

- Photography Categories

- Photography



The “Photography Categories” will be as shown with the three tabs “Wine”, “Landscape” and “Products” but we will add more in the future.



The Photography page will be a grid listing of each photography entry and we will make the page full width and be responsive to go from wide browsers down to mobile and will have it drop off the least important columns as it gets smaller.



The Add New / Edit page for each photography entry will have all of the fields that match our current attached images.

- Photo Name

- Photo Description

- Location of Photo

- Year

- Tags

- Photo Details (this could be Json maybe)

    - Location

    - Year

    - Category

- Technical Details (this could be JSON as well)

    - Camera

    - Lens

    - Settings

- We need to make the image upload section be able to upload a new image or choose one from our server, which our photography photos are held in the following folder or its sub folders: `/assets/images/photography/`

 On the frontend we will make it look like the attached screenshots and use the original `photography.html` file for reference on layout, design, styling.

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,51 @@
- 
+ PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;
+ 
+ -- Photography Categories (Wine, Landscape, Products, etc.)
+ CREATE TABLE photography_categories (
+   id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+   code            TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,   -- e.g., &quot;wine&quot;, &quot;landscape&quot;, &quot;products&quot;
+   label           TEXT NOT NULL,          -- display name
+   description     TEXT,
+   color           TEXT,                   -- color code for UI (e.g., &quot;purple&quot;, &quot;blue&quot;, &quot;green&quot;)
+   icon            TEXT,                   -- Font Awesome icon class
+   display_order   INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
+   created_at      TEXT DEFAULT (datetime(&#39;now&#39;)),
+   updated_at      TEXT DEFAULT (datetime(&#39;now&#39;))
+ );
+ 
+ -- Seed initial categories
+ INSERT INTO photography_categories (code, label, description, color, icon, display_order) VALUES
+ (&#39;wine&#39;, &#39;Wine&#39;, &#39;Wine photography&#39;, &#39;purple&#39;, &#39;fas fa-wine-glass&#39;, 1),
+ (&#39;landscape&#39;, &#39;Landscape&#39;, &#39;Landscape photography&#39;, &#39;blue&#39;, &#39;fas fa-mountain&#39;, 2),
+ (&#39;products&#39;, &#39;Products&#39;, &#39;Product photography&#39;, &#39;green&#39;, &#39;fas fa-box&#39;, 3);
+ 
+ -- Photography entries table
+ CREATE TABLE photography (
+   id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+   category_id     INTEGER REFERENCES photography_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
+   
+   photo_name      TEXT NOT NULL,          -- Photo Name
+   photo_description TEXT,                 -- Photo Description
+   location        TEXT,                   -- Location of Photo
+   year            TEXT,                    -- Year
+   
+   tags            TEXT,                   -- comma-separated tags
+   
+   -- Photo Details (stored as JSON)
+   photo_details   TEXT,                   -- JSON: {location, year, category}
+   
+   -- Technical Details (stored as JSON)
+   technical_details TEXT,                 -- JSON: {camera, lens, settings}
+   
+   -- Image URL (main photo)
+   image_url       TEXT,                   -- e.g., &quot;/assets/images/photography/...&quot;
+   
+   created_at      TEXT DEFAULT (datetime(&#39;now&#39;)),
+   updated_at      TEXT DEFAULT (datetime(&#39;now&#39;))
+ );
+ 
+ -- Indexes
+ CREATE INDEX idx_photography_category ON photography(category_id);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_photography_year ON photography(year);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_photography_categories_display_order ON photography_categories(display_order);
+ 
```

```diff
+ def list_photography_images() -&gt; List[dict]:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;List all images in the photography directory&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     images = []
+     if PHOTOGRAPHY_IMG_ROOT.exists():
+         for ext in IMAGE_EXTENSIONS:
+             for img_file in PHOTOGRAPHY_IMG_ROOT.rglob(f&quot;*{ext}&quot;):
+                 rel_path = img_file.relative_to(ROOT)
+                 url = &quot;/&quot; + str(rel_path).replace(&quot;\\&quot;, &quot;/&quot;)
+                 images.append({
+                     &quot;url&quot;: url,
+                     &quot;filename&quot;: img_file.name,
+                     &quot;path&quot;: str(rel_path),
+                 })
+     return sorted(images, key=lambda x: x[&quot;filename&quot;])
+ 
+ 
+ @app.get(&quot;/admin/photography&quot;)
+ def photography_list(request: Request) -&gt; Any:
+     try:
+         with get_photography_conn() as conn:
+             photos_rows = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                 SELECT 
+                     p.*,
+                     c.label AS category_label,
+                     c.code AS category_code,
+                     c.color AS category_color
+                 FROM photography p
+                 LEFT JOIN photography_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
+                 ORDER BY p.year DESC, p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
+             &quot;&quot;&quot;).fetchall()
+             photos = [dict(row) for row in photos_rows]
+     except Exception:
+         photos = []
+     return templates.TemplateResponse(
+         &quot;photography/photography_list.html&quot;,
+         {&quot;request&quot;: request, &quot;photos&quot;: photos},

+     technical_details: str | None = Form(None),
+     image_url: str | None = Form(None),

+     photo_pk = _optional_int(photo_id)

+     # Validate and parse JSON fields
+     photo_details_json = &quot;{}&quot;
+     if photo_details:
+         try:
+             parsed = json.loads(photo_details)
+             photo_details_json = json.dumps(parsed, ensure_ascii=False)
+         except json.JSONDecodeError:
+             photo_details_json = &quot;{}&quot;
+     
+     technical_details_json = &quot;{}&quot;
+     if technical_details:

+             technical_details_json = json.dumps(parsed, ensure_ascii=False)
+         except json.JSONDecodeError:
+             technical_details_json = &quot;{}&quot;

+     with get_photography_conn() as conn:
+         cur = conn.cursor()
+         if photo_pk is None:
+             cur.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;

+                 (photo_name, photo_description, location, year, tags, category_id, photo_details, technical_details, image_url)
+                 VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

+                 image_url.strip() if image_url else None,

+         else:
+             cur.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;

+ @app.post(&quot;/admin/photography/images/upload&quot;)
+ def photography_image_upload(
+     photo_id: int = Form(...),
+     file: UploadFile = File(...),
+ ) -&gt; RedirectResponse:
+     if not file.filename:
+         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=&quot;No file provided&quot;)
+     
+     ext = Path(file.filename).suffix.lower()
+     if ext not in IMAGE_EXTENSIONS:
+         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f&quot;Unsupported image format: {ext}&quot;)
+     
+     photo_img_dir = PHOTOGRAPHY_IMG_ROOT
+     photo_img_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+     
+     safe_filename = secrets.token_urlsafe(8) + ext
+     file_path = photo_img_dir / safe_filename
+     url = f&quot;/assets/images/photography/{safe_filename}&quot;
+     
+     with file_path.open(&quot;wb&quot;) as f:
+         content = file.file.read()
+         f.write(content)
+     
+     return RedirectResponse(url=f&quot;/admin/photography/{photo_id}&quot;, status_code=303)
```

```diff
+                             @click=&quot;goToPage(page)&quot;

+                 &lt;button type=&quot;button&quot; class=&quot;rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 disabled:opacity-40&quot; @click=&quot;nextPage&quot; :disabled=&quot;currentPage === totalPages()&quot;&gt;Next&lt;/button&gt;

+ &lt;script&gt;
+ function photographyCategoriesTable(initial) {
+     return {
+         perPageOptions: [10, 20, 30, 50, 100],
+         perPage: 10,
+         currentPage: 1,
+         categories: initial.categories || [],
+         init() {
+             this.$watch(&#39;perPage&#39;, () =&gt; { this.currentPage = 1; });
+         },
+         totalPages() {
+             const total = this.categories.length;
+             return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / this.perPage));
+         },
+         paginatedCategories() {
+             const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.perPage;
+             return this.categories.slice(start, start + this.perPage);
+         },
+         goToPage(page) {
+             const total = this.totalPages();
+             this.currentPage = Math.min(Math.max(page, 1), total);
+         },
+         prevPage() {
+             this.goToPage(this.currentPage - 1);
+         },
+         nextPage() {
+             this.goToPage(this.currentPage + 1);
+         },
+         pageNumbers() {
+             const total = this.totalPages();
+             if (total === 0) return [];
+             if (total === 1) return [1];
+             
+             const current = this.currentPage;
+             const pages = [];
+             
+             const start = Math.max(1, current - 1);
+             const end = Math.min(total, current + 1);
+             
+             for (let i = start; i &lt;= end; i++) {
+                 pages.push(i);
+             }
+             
+             return pages;
+         },
+         rangeSummary() {
+             if (!this.categories.length) {
+                 return &#39;Showing 0 items&#39;;
+             }
+             const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.perPage + 1;
+             const end = Math.min(start + this.perPage - 1, this.categories.length);
+             return &#96;Showing ${start}-${end} of ${this.categories.length} items&#96;;
+         },
+     };
+ }
+ &lt;/script&gt;
+ {% endblock %}
+
```

```diff
+             &lt;p class=&quot;text-sm text-slate-500 text-center&quot; x-text=&quot;rangeSummary()&quot;&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
+             
+             &lt;!-- Right: Page navigation --&gt;
+             &lt;div class=&quot;flex items-center gap-2&quot;&gt;
+                 &lt;button type=&quot;button&quot; class=&quot;rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 disabled:opacity-40&quot; @click=&quot;prevPage&quot; :disabled=&quot;currentPage === 1&quot;&gt;Prev&lt;/button&gt;
+                 &lt;template x-for=&quot;page in pageNumbers()&quot; :key=&quot;&#39;photo-page-&#39; + page&quot;&gt;
+                     &lt;button type=&quot;button&quot; class=&quot;rounded-lg border px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold&quot; 
+                             :class=&quot;page === currentPage ? &#39;border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 text-blue-700&#39; : &#39;border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100&#39;&quot; 
+                             @click=&quot;goToPage(page)&quot; 
+                             x-text=&quot;page&quot;&gt;&lt;/button&gt;
+                 &lt;/template&gt;
+                 &lt;button type=&quot;button&quot; class=&quot;rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 disabled:opacity-40&quot; @click=&quot;nextPage&quot; :disabled=&quot;currentPage === totalPages()&quot;&gt;Next&lt;/button&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/section&gt;
+ &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+ &lt;script&gt;
+ function photographyTable(initial) {
+     return {
+         perPageOptions: [12, 24, 36, 48, 60],
+         perPage: 24,
+         currentPage: 1,
+         photos: initial.photos || [],
+         init() {
+             this.$watch(&#39;perPage&#39;, () =&gt; { this.currentPage = 1; });
+         },
+         totalPages() {
+             const total = this.photos.length;
+             return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / this.perPage));
+         },
+         paginatedPhotos() {
+             const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.perPage;
+             return this.photos.slice(start, start + this.perPage);
+         },
+         goToPage(page) {
+             const total = this.totalPages();
+             this.currentPage = Math.min(Math.max(page, 1), total);
+         },
+         prevPage() {
+             this.goToPage(this.currentPage - 1);
+         },
+         nextPage() {
+             this.goToPage(this.currentPage + 1);
+         },
+         pageNumbers() {
+             const total = this.totalPages();
+             if (total === 0) return [];
+             if (total === 1) return [1];
+             
+             const current = this.currentPage;
+             const pages = [];
+             
+             const start = Math.max(1, current - 1);
+             const end = Math.min(total, current + 1);
+             
+             for (let i = start; i &lt;= end; i++) {
+                 pages.push(i);
+             }
+             
+             return pages;
+         },
+         rangeSummary() {
+             if (!this.photos.length) {
+                 return &#39;Showing 0 items&#39;;
+             }
+             const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.perPage + 1;
+             const end = Math.min(start + this.perPage - 1, this.photos.length);
+             return &#96;Showing ${start}-${end} of ${this.photos.length} items&#96;;
+         },
+     };
+ }
+ &lt;/script&gt;
+ {% endblock %}
+
```

```diff
+ @app.get(&quot;/api/photography&quot;)
+ def api_photography() -&gt; JSONResponse:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;API endpoint to fetch all photography entries for frontend&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     try:
+         with get_photography_conn() as conn:
+             # Get categories - convert Row objects to dicts
+             categories_rows = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                 SELECT id, code, label, color, icon, display_order
+                 FROM photography_categories
+                 ORDER BY display_order, label
+             &quot;&quot;&quot;).fetchall()
+             categories = [dict(row) for row in categories_rows]
+             
+             # Get photos with category info - convert Row objects to dicts
+             photos_rows = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                 SELECT 
+                     p.*,
+                     c.code AS category_code,
+                     c.label AS category_label,
+                     c.color AS category_color
+                 FROM photography p
+                 LEFT JOIN photography_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
+                 ORDER BY p.year DESC, p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
+             &quot;&quot;&quot;).fetchall()
+             photos = [dict(row) for row in photos_rows]
+             
+             # Parse JSON fields
+             photos_list = []
+             for photo in photos:
+                 photo_details = {}
+                 if photo.get(&quot;photo_details&quot;):
+                     try:
+                         photo_details = json.loads(photo[&quot;photo_details&quot;])
+                     except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                         photo_details = {}
+                 
+                 technical_details = {}
+                 if photo.get(&quot;technical_details&quot;):
+                     try:
+                         technical_details = json.loads(photo[&quot;technical_details&quot;])
+                     except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                         technical_details = {}
+                 
+                 photos_list.append({
+                     &quot;id&quot;: photo[&quot;id&quot;],
+                     &quot;title&quot;: photo[&quot;photo_name&quot;],
+                     &quot;description&quot;: photo[&quot;photo_description&quot;] or &quot;&quot;,
+                     &quot;location&quot;: photo[&quot;location&quot;] or photo_details.get(&quot;location&quot;, &quot;&quot;),
+                     &quot;year&quot;: photo[&quot;year&quot;] or photo_details.get(&quot;year&quot;, &quot;&quot;),
+                     &quot;category&quot;: photo[&quot;category_label&quot;] or photo_details.get(&quot;category&quot;, &quot;&quot;),
+                     &quot;category_code&quot;: photo[&quot;category_code&quot;] or &quot;&quot;,
+                     &quot;image&quot;: photo[&quot;image_url&quot;] or &quot;&quot;,
+                     &quot;camera&quot;: technical_details.get(&quot;camera&quot;, &quot;&quot;),
+                     &quot;lens&quot;: technical_details.get(&quot;lens&quot;, &quot;&quot;),
+                     &quot;settings&quot;: technical_details.get(&quot;settings&quot;, &quot;&quot;),
+                     &quot;tags&quot;: photo[&quot;tags&quot;] or &quot;&quot;,
+                 })
+             
+             # Group photos by category code
+             photos_by_category = {}
+             for photo in photos_list:
+                 cat_code = photo[&quot;category_code&quot;] or &quot;uncategorized&quot;
+                 if cat_code not in photos_by_category:
+                     photos_by_category[cat_code] = []
+                 photos_by_category[cat_code].append(photo)
+             
+             # Build categories list with counts

+                 &quot;color&quot;: cat.get(&quot;color&quot;) or &quot;&quot;,
+                 &quot;icon&quot;: cat.get(&quot;icon&quot;) or &quot;&quot;,
+                 &quot;count&quot;: len(photos_by_category.get(cat.get(&quot;code&quot;) or &quot;&quot;, []))
```

   - Routes for Photography entries (list, new, edit, save)
   - Image upload route with browse functionality
   - API endpoint `/api/photography` for frontend consumption

3. **Admin templates** — Created:
   - `photography_categories_list.html` — Category management with pagination
   - `photography_category_edit.html` — Category add/edit form
   - `photography_list.html` — Responsive grid layout (1-5 columns based on screen size)
   - `photography_edit.html` — Full edit form with all fields, JSON editors, and image browser

4. **Admin sidebar** — Replaced "Coming Soon" with active Photography and Categories links

5. **Frontend** — Updated `photography.html` to:
   - Fetch data from `/api/photography` endpoint
   - Dynamically generate category buttons from database
   - Display photos grouped by category
   - Show loading states

The system matches the structure of Documents, Side Projects, and Portfolios. The admin interface supports full CRUD operations, and the frontend pulls data from the SQLite database via the API endpoint. The responsive grid layout adapts from wide browsers down to mobile, dropping less important columns as the screen gets smaller.

---


Fixed the route ordering issue. FastAPI matches routes in order, so `/admin/photography/{photo_id}` was matching before `/admin/photography/categories`, causing "categories" to be parsed as `photo_id`.

Moved all category routes before the parameterized route. The order is now:
1. `/admin/photography` - list
2. `/admin/photography/new` - new photo
3. `/admin/photography/categories` - categories list (specific routes first)
4. `/admin/photography/categories/new` - new category
5. `/admin/photography/categories/{category_id}` - edit category
6. `/admin/photography/{photo_id}` - edit photo (parameterized route last)

The categories page should work now. Restart the FastAPI server if it's running to pick up the changes.

Fixed the Alpine.js scoping issue. The image browser modal was outside the form's `x-data` scope.

**What I changed:**
1. Moved `x-data="photographyForm()"` from the `<form>` to the outer container `<div>` (line 7)
2. Added the missing closing `</div>` tag for the outer container

Now the structure is:
- Outer `<div>` with `x-data="photographyForm()"` (contains everything)
  - `<form>` (the form fields)
  - Image Browser Modal (now in the same scope)
  - `<script>` (the JavaScript function)

All Alpine.js variables (`showBrowserModal`, `browserLoading`, `availableImages`, `selectedBrowserImage`) are now accessible throughout the component, including the modal. The errors should be resolved.

Fixed the undefined variable errors. Changes:

1. **Moved the script to the top** — The `photographyForm()` function is defined before Alpine.js initializes.

2. **Added null checks and safe defaults** — All variables are initialized with safe defaults and checked before use.

3. **Used `x-if` templates** — Replaced `x-show` with `x-if` for conditional rendering to avoid evaluating expressions when variables are undefined.

4. **Explicit boolean checks** — Used `=== true` and `=== false` to avoid truthy/falsy issues.

5. **Added `x-cloak`** — Prevents flash of unstyled content while Alpine initializes.

6. **Safe property access** — All expressions use fallbacks (e.g., `img.url || ''`, `availableImages && availableImages.length`).

All Alpine.js variables are now properly defined and initialized:
- `imageUrl` — initialized as empty string
- `showBrowserModal` — initialized as `false`
- `browserLoading` — initialized as `false`
- `availableImages` — initialized as empty array
- `selectedBrowserImage` — initialized as `null`

The undefined errors should be resolved. The form should work without console errors.

---


Fixed the JSON parsing error. The issue was that when there's no image URL, the template output `'""'`, which Jinja2 HTML-escaped to `&#34;&#34;`, making it invalid JSON.

**The fix:**
Changed from:
```jinja
{{ (photo.image_url | tojson | safe) if photo and photo.image_url else '""' }}
```

To:
```jinja
{{ (photo.image_url if photo and photo.image_url else '') | tojson | safe }}
```

Now the `tojson` filter is applied to the value (either the image URL or an empty string), which properly JSON-encodes it. This ensures:
- When there's an image URL, it's properly JSON-encoded
- When there's no image URL, it outputs `""` (a valid JSON empty string)
- No HTML escaping issues

The console error should be resolved.
